name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
title: CWE-835: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
ai_text: In AI software this weakness shows up in LLM chat applications, as the three CVEs here all sit in Open WebUI, a self-hosted interface for talking to models. The usual way in is an ordinary logged-in account, not a privileged one. A user starts a chat cycle, or nests a folder inside itself, and the loop's exit condition can never be reached. The server then spins without finishing, so it stops answering. In the two later cases the whole instance freezes for every user, not just the one who triggered it. The result is a denial of service against a shared AI tool, reached through normal features rather than any flaw in the model itself.
description: The product contains an iteration or loop with an exit condition that cannot be reached, i.e., an infinite loop.

consequences.note: An infinite loop will cause unexpected consumption of resources, such as CPU cycles or memory. The software's operation may slow down, or cause a long time to respond.
